title: 1. Purpose
content: BeeConnect is a platform that brings together beekeepers and citizens to promote bee health, share knowledge, and build a more sustainable environment.

title: 2. For Beekeepers
content: You agree to provide accurate information about your hives.
You are responsible for the health and safety of your bees.
You agree to follow best practices and local regulations.

title: 3. For Citizen
content: You agree to use the platform to learn, engage, and support bee conservation.
You may report bee sightings or environmental concerns honestly.
You agree to respect beekeepers and their work.

title: 4. General
content: We reserve the right to update these terms. Continued use of the platform means you accept the updated terms.

title: 5. Data Privacy
content: BeeGuard is committed to protecting users' personal information in accordance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173). Personal information, submitted reports, photographs, and location data will be collected and processed only for legitimate purposes related to BeeGuard's features and services. Appropriate security measures will be implemented to protect this information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. Users may exercise their applicable data privacy rights under the law.
